files.prompt: Game UI asset style sheet for a video player skin called Ink Wheel, laid out on a plain warm off-white paper background, every piece separated with generous space. Visual language: Japanese sumi ink and torn washi paper, rough dry-brush edges, ink spatter, faint hairline cracks, one accent colour only: vermillion seal red (#D9472B). Pieces: 1) a large circular black ink splash disc seen from above, rough organic edge with spatter droplets; 2) a paper-white dry-brush circle stroke, ring shaped, hollow centre; 3) a small vermillion ink seal knob; 4) three round buttons: plain ink disc, paper disc with vermillion rim, hover version with brighter rim; 5) a portrait playing card in cream paper with deckled edges, ink border, small corner ornaments and an empty rectangular window; 6) the matching card back with an ink wheel emblem; 7) a vermillion square stamp reading SEEN; 8) a wide flat ink pool splash; 9) a paper pill button and an ink pill button. Flat even lighting, no text except SEEN, no logos, no shadows on the background, crisp clean cut-out edges.
